title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Lehigh University
description: Ten under-21-safe food destinations with currently published late availability in Bethlehem or on campus.

cards.title: MarketX
cards.subtitle: Building C, Lehigh Mountaintop Campus
cards.notes: Bring your Lehigh ID for access to this self-checkout market when other Mountaintop food service is closed.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 campus market with prepared food, snacks, drinks, and microwavable meals.
cards.evidence_claim: Lehigh states that MarketX is open 24/7 and requires ID for entry.
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7; located on Building C's second floor. Lehigh student, faculty, or staff ID is required for entry.

cards.title: Hawk's Nest at Lamberton Hall
cards.subtitle: Lamberton Hall, Asa Packer Campus
cards.notes: Check the current dining schedule before heading over; the university describes it as a late-night campus food option.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus diner in Lamberton Hall with late weekend availability described by Lehigh.
cards.evidence_claim: A Lehigh campus video says Hawk's Nest stays open until about 4 a.m. on weekends.
cards.access_notes: Lehigh describes weekend operation until about 4 a.m.; verify the dining schedule for the specific date.

cards.title: El Jefe's Taqueria
cards.subtitle: 506 E. 3rd St., Bethlehem
cards.notes: Use the pickup or delivery link if you need food after most nearby counters have closed.
cards.short_summary: A SouthSide taqueria with breakfast through late-night service every day.
cards.evidence_claim: El Jefe's official Bethlehem page lists daily hours of 8 a.m. to 3 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Open 8 a.m.–3 a.m., seven days a week, according to the location's official page.

cards.title: Sizzling Bites
cards.subtitle: 312 E. 3rd St., Suite 102, Bethlehem
cards.notes: Order pickup or delivery directly from the location when you need a meal late in the evening.
cards.short_summary: A halal fast-casual restaurant serving platters, gyros, burgers, fries, and desserts.
cards.evidence_claim: Sizzling Bites lists Bethlehem hours until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: LJ's Midnight Munchies
cards.subtitle: 748 E. 4th St., Bethlehem
cards.notes: Plan this for Thursday through Saturday and confirm the posted online ordering window before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A late-evening pickup spot offering sandwiches, burgers, fried sides, and desserts.
cards.evidence_claim: LJ's official ordering page lists Thursday, Friday, and Saturday hours from 9 p.m. to 4 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Open 9 p.m.–4 a.m. Thursday, Friday, and Saturday; pickup service is listed.

cards.title: Lehigh Pizza
cards.subtitle: 13 W. 3rd St., Bethlehem
cards.notes: Place a pickup, curbside, or delivery order before the stated last-order cutoff rather than arriving at closing.
cards.short_summary: A pizza shop close to campus with late weekday and midnight weekend closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: Lehigh Pizza lists hours until 11 p.m. Monday–Thursday and midnight Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open to 11 p.m. Monday–Thursday and midnight Friday–Saturday; new orders stop 15 minutes before closing.

cards.title: Sorella's Pizza & Pasta
cards.subtitle: 3650 Nazareth Pike, Bethlehem
cards.notes: Use the Friday or Saturday midnight window for carryout or delivery; check the business page for the current menu.
cards.short_summary: A Bethlehem pizza-and-pasta restaurant with late Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Sorella's official site lists Friday and Saturday business hours from 9 a.m. to midnight.
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight on Friday and Saturday; carryout and delivery are offered.

cards.title: Anna's Brick Oven Pizza
cards.subtitle: 313 S. New St., Bethlehem
cards.notes: Choose this SouthSide counter for an evening pizza order, and verify closing time if your visit is close to 10 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A SouthSide brick-oven pizza restaurant with nightly service until 10 p.m. on weekdays and weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Anna's official Bethlehem page lists Monday–Saturday hours until 10 p.m. and Sunday hours until 9 p.m.
cards.source_title: Anna's Brick Oven Pizza | Bethlehem, PA
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are 10 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday–Saturday and 11 a.m.–9 p.m. Sunday.

cards.title: The Barbecue Boys
cards.subtitle: 306 S. New St., Suite 109, Bethlehem
cards.notes: Order directly for pickup when you want a food-only stop with an 11 p.m. closing time.
cards.short_summary: A SouthSide barbecue restaurant with a menu of smoked meats, chicken, sides, and nonalcoholic drinks.
cards.evidence_claim: The Barbecue Boys' direct ordering page lists daily hours from 11:30 a.m. to 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: The direct ordering page lists daily hours until 11 p.m.

cards.title: 24 East Bistro
cards.subtitle: 24 E. 3rd St., Bethlehem
cards.notes: Reserve or arrange takeout for a Friday or Saturday evening; published weekend dinner hours run later than weekdays.
cards.short_summary: A SouthSide Japanese restaurant with Friday and Saturday dinner service until 10:30 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Apple Maps lists 24 East Bistro open until 10:30 p.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Friday 4:30–10:30 p.m. and Saturday 4–10:30 p.m.; weekday dinner ends earlier.
